source_text.body:
Build a social networking feature with auth and feeds
A reviewer asked Replit Agent 3 to build a social networking feature with authentication and feeds, and it ran autonomously for 193 minutes.
Done with
RA
Replit Agent
What they did
The reviewer turned on Replit Agent 3's Max Autonomy mode and asked for a social networking feature with authentication and feeds. The agent ran on its own for 193 minutes. It created files, tested endpoints, fixed bugs and iterated. The source doesn't describe any prompts or interventions during the run.
How it went
The reviewer says it got about 80% of the way there without intervention. The result still needed polish, and the source gives no further detail on what was left.
Worth knowing
Max Autonomy can burn credits fast, and the reviewer advises setting a spending cap first and reviewing the agent's architecture and database choices.
Try it yourself
with
Replit Agent
Copy prompt
Add a social networking feature to my app: user sign-up and login, user profiles, the ability to post, and a feed of posts from [people they follow / everyone]. Work through it step by step and test each part in the browser as you go. Stop when I can create two accounts, post from each, and see the posts in the feeds, then summarize what you built and what's left.
Original source: https://0xminds.com/blog/guides/replit-agent-3-review-2025
